title: 2-D IDCT
text: Compute 2-D inverse discrete cosine transform (IDCT), 1 input, 1 output; {Sine and cosine computation} sets how the block computes sine and cosine terms Table and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the data type override. Values come from the instance.

params.values: How the block computes sine and cosine terms Table lookup (default) | Trigonometric fcn
